name: debuff
long_description: Make 2D browser games with Claude using debuff, an open-source TypeScript framework. Point it at your game folder and Claude can play the game headless or attach to the tab you have open under `debuff dev`, send input, step time, take captures, tune feel params live, run scenario tests and read runtime errors that say whose problem they are. You keep the creative calls.
